reason: The invoice bug last month means I actually feel this pain, so I'd star the repo. But a screen recording plus an AI exploring my client apps in a sandbox is a heavy setup, not a one-minute CLI, and I'm not wiring a student side project into client work until I see it survive a few months.
objection: Will this still be maintained next year? If I build my regression checks on it and the author graduates and walks away, I'm stuck with broken tooling right when a client update goes out. I also don't know what running Meta's models locally costs me in setup, keys or hardware.
would_change_my_mind: A README with a 60-second demo catching a real changed total on a sample web app, installable in one command, plus visible commit activity and more than one maintainer.
